scripts.sync-data: rm -rf public/data && mkdir -p public/data && cp -r ../data/out/. public/data/
scripts.sync-index: rm -rf public/data && mkdir -p public/data && (cp ../data/out/index.json public/data/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build: npm run sync-index && tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run prerender
scripts.prepare-output: rm -rf .vercel/output && mkdir -p .vercel/output/static && node scripts/csp.mjs && node scripts/edge.mjs && cp -r dist/. .vercel/output/static/ && rm -rf .vercel/output/static/data
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run prepare-output && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --archive=tgz
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr src/prerender-entry.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
